name: gateway-vscode
description: Connect Web AI to Local VS Code

commands.title: webcode: Clean Legacy Isolated Browser Profiles

webcodeGateway.aiSites.description: User-defined list of AI platforms. Leave empty to use the built-in platform registry managed by the VS Code extension.

id.description: Stable site id. Use a built-in id such as chatgpt to override that site, or a new id to add a complete custom site.

showQuickLaunch.description: Show in the main quick pick menu

browser.description: Specific browser for this site (overrides global setting). Use user-profile-chrome or user-profile-edge to launch the normal profile and try to apply anti-freeze flags. Use isolated-chrome or isolated-edge to launch a dedicated profile with the bridge extension and anti-freeze flags.

capture.description: Optional browser response capture configuration. Parser implementations remain bundled with webcode.

url.description: Exact response endpoint; query parameters are ignored when matching.

selectors.description: DOM selectors for this AI site. Leave empty to use defaults for known sites.

virtualizedMessages.description: Enable conservative history-scroll protection for virtualized chat lists.

webcodeGateway.port.description: The port the local gateway server will listen on. The browser bridge extension only supports ports 34567-34576.

webcodeGateway.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes without authenticated gateway activity before automatic shutdown. Authenticated health checks from a connected browser tab count as activity; anonymous requests, rejected requests, and invalid bridge codes do not extend the timeout.

webcodeGateway.timeouts.markdownDescription: Deadlines for gateway tooling and bridge handshakes. Out-of-range values are clamped into the documented range, non-numeric values fall back to the default, and a value of 0 on an item whose minimum is 0 disables that deadline.

commandExecutionMs.markdownDescription: Deadline in milliseconds for `execute_command`; the command is stopped when it overruns. Raise this for long builds, or use `run_in_terminal` for commands that must keep running in a visible terminal.

commandExecutionMaxMs.markdownDescription: Ceiling in milliseconds for the `timeout` an AI may request on `execute_command`. The effective deadline is the smaller of the requested value and this ceiling, so `commandExecutionMs` supplies the default while this setting bounds it. `0` disables the ceiling. Keep `toolCallMs` at `0` or above this ceiling, otherwise the gateway deadline fires before the command deadline.

toolCallMs.markdownDescription: Deadline in milliseconds for one tool call handled by the gateway, including third-party MCP tools. `0` disables the deadline and leaves long calls bounded only by the idle shutdown watchdog.

bridgeCodeTtlSeconds.markdownDescription: Lifetime in seconds of the single-use bridge code that links a browser tab to this gateway. Raise it when installing or reloading the browser extension takes longer than the code stays valid.

approvalTtlSeconds.markdownDescription: Lifetime in seconds of a command approval challenge, and of the approval token issued from it. Raise it when approvals are reviewed slowly.

browserLaunchWaitMs.markdownDescription: How long in milliseconds to wait for an isolated browser to expose its WebCode bridge process after launch. Raise it on slow disks or when antivirus scanning delays browser start.

bridgeRequestMs.markdownDescription: Deadline in milliseconds for browser-to-gateway tool requests issued by the bridge extension. `0` disables the deadline.

webcodeGateway.autoStart.description: Start the gateway automatically after VS Code activates the extension. Off by default, which keeps activation free of side effects. Auto-start never opens a browser; it only brings the gateway and its MCP servers up. Skipped when no workspace folder is open.

webcodeGateway.browser.description: Global default browser. Used if no site-specific browser is configured. Edge isolated mode is recommended because it launches a dedicated profile with the bundled bridge extension and anti-freeze flags, so no separate browser extension install is needed. Use regular or user-profile browser modes only after installing the browser extension manually.

webcodeGateway.isolatedChrome.executable.description: Optional path to a Chrome for Testing or Chromium executable for isolated-chrome mode. Google Chrome 137+ no longer supports automatic unpacked extension loading.

webcodeGateway.isolatedBrowser.profileRo.description: Optional absolute directory, or a path starting with ~, where isolated browser profiles are stored. Leave empty to use the OS app data directory. webcode creates edge and chrome subdirectories.

webcodeGateway.commandShell.path.description: Optional path to the POSIX shell used by execute_command and run_in_terminal. On Windows this should point to Git Bash bash.exe. Leave empty to auto-detect Git Bash on Windows or use the user/system POSIX shell on macOS and Linux.

webcodeGateway.command.allowedRoots.description: Additional absolute directories trusted by command path risk checks. Paths outside trusted roots require per-command approval. Supports ~ and ${workspaceFolder}.

webcodeGateway.command.denyRules.markdownDescription: Commands that are always rejected. A rule matches as a case-insensitive substring of the command line after whitespace is collapsed, so keep rules distinctive (4 or more characters is recommended). A matching command is blocked outright: no approval prompt, no browser-side allow rule and no approval token can override it. This is a guardrail, not a sandbox: quoting tricks and scripts can still evade a rule.

webcodeGateway.ripgrep.path.description: Optional absolute path to ripgrep for search_files and search_code. Leave empty to use VS Code's bundled ripgrep or rg from PATH.

webcodeGateway.skillDirectories.description: Additional workspace-relative directories to scan for skill folders that contain SKILL.md. These are merged with the built-in default skill directories.

disabled.description: Disable this server. If true, the server will not be started.

toolTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: Per-request deadline in milliseconds for tool calls on this server. Raise it for MCP tools that legitimately run longer than a minute. Leave the default to keep the MCP SDK's own 60 second request timeout.

webcodeGateway.servers.description: Additional third-party MCP servers. Built-in filesystem and command capabilities are implemented locally by webcode.

scripts.prepare-browser-extension: pnpm --filter bridge-browser run build && node scripts/copy-browser-extension.mjs
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run lint
scripts.pretest:extension: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
